summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Prospecteur feature (iter28). 11/11 pytest cases passed. UI flows for admin (sidebar nav-prospecteur between Commissions and Stock, Prospecteur page, Nouvelle vente block with select+commission+quick buttons 400/500/600), prospecteur read-only view (sees only own clients, no Montant, redirect /ventes→/prospecteur, sidebar has only nav-prospecteur), and regressions (Autre (préciser) custom cheque installments, Sous-traitance source, dashboard executive endpoint) all verified. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 9942 lines — should be split into routers (users, sales, prospection, dashboard...). Not blocking but increasingly hard to maintain.

GET /api/prospecteurs is open to all authenticated users of the company (no role gate). Low priority: prospecteur role sees own id via /auth/me anyway; but could be scoped to admin/responsable for consistency with PUT /prospection RBAC.
seed_data_creation: Tests create sales prefixed with TEST_Service and delete them in a final cleanup test. TEST_Prospecteur user preserved. No orphan data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file test_prospecteur_iter28.py is self-cleaning. Playwright login tip: use page.press('[data-testid="login-password-input"]','Enter') — the Button click with force=True does NOT reliably trigger the form onSubmit on this app (observed empty field re-render). All sales/prospection endpoints verified: POST /api/sales with prospecteur_id→sets prospecteur_name; PUT /api/sales clears when prospecteur_id=''; PUT /api/prospection/{sid} is admin/responsable only (prospecteur gets 403); GET /api/sales returns 403 for prospecteur; dashboard/executive endpoint responds 200. Admin sidebar order confirmed: ... commissions, prospecteur, stock ...
